opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), up to £300 for Scheme (C).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics.

opportunities.title: Genes & Development Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses, and a place on the Summer School Workshop.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support undergraduate students in gaining experience in genetics through a research project during the summer holiday.
